description: This file declares interfaces and prototypes for integrating AdbWinApi and AdbWinUsbApi DLLs, focusing on USB driver compatibility for Android Debug Bridge (ADB) on Windows systems. It includes documentation and a function pointer type for instantiating a WinUsb interface.

classes.name: AdbInterfaceObject
classes.description: A class representing an interface object for ADB's WinUsb API interactions.

methods.name: InstantiateWinUsbInterface
methods.description: A function pointer type defining the prototype for instantiating a WinUsb interface by loading AdbWinUsbApi.dll and retrieving the export.
